sql: INSERT INTO acs_ratings (name, slug, uploaded_at, status) VALUES ('Part 91 Refresher','p91',datetime('now'),'parsed')
INSERT INTO acs_areas (rating_id, code, title, order_index) SELECT id,'I','Area I',1 FROM acs_ratings WHERE slug='p91'
INSERT INTO acs_areas (rating_id, code, title, order_index) SELECT id,'II','Area II',2 FROM acs_ratings WHERE slug='p91'
INSERT INTO acs_tasks (area_id, code, title, acs_references, order_index) SELECT id,'A','Flight Review and Currency','x',1 FROM acs_areas WHERE code='I' AND title='Area I'
INSERT INTO acs_tasks (area_id, code, title, acs_references, order_index) SELECT id,'A','Preflight Action and Fuel Requirements','x',1 FROM acs_areas WHERE code='II' AND title='Area II'
INSERT INTO acs_tasks (area_id, code, title, acs_references, order_index) SELECT id,'B','Airworthiness Requirements','x',2 FROM acs_areas WHERE code='II' AND title='Area II'
INSERT INTO acs_task_elements (task_id, kind, code, text, order_index) SELECT id,'knowledge','K1','Element '||id,1 FROM acs_tasks WHERE title<>'zz' AND acs_references='x'
INSERT INTO academy_course_grants (student_id, rating_id, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT {student}, id,'t',datetime('now') FROM acs_ratings WHERE slug='p91'

INSERT INTO gs_assignments (student_id, task_id, due_on, assigned_by_name, assigned_at) SELECT {student}, t.id, date('now','+3 days'),'Cfi',datetime('now') FROM acs_tasks t JOIN acs_areas a ON a.id=t.area_id WHERE a.title='Area II'
